verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's registered agent docs promise an alert "as soon as official mail arrives." They also describe scanning and uploading documents, emailing the customer with follow-up reminders if the email goes unopened, and mailing a postcard, which is the immediate-notification core of the story. The evidence is vendor claims only, and none of it explicitly addresses lawsuits or service of process. Missing for 10: explicit service-of-process or lawsuit-specific escalation handling, faster urgent channels beyond email and postcard (e.g., phone/SMS), any stated notification turnaround time, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
